description: List promoted learning rules ("lessons") for the current project, highest-frequency first. Returns { lessons: [{ id, rule_text, severity, frequency, anti_pattern, … }] }. Read-only. Use to browse the full catalog of encoded heuristics; use query_lessons to retrieve only lessons relevant to a specific diff or PR within a token budget.

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to configured project (`project_id` is accepted too.)

name: list_lessons

lessons.description: Promoted lesson rows ordered by frequency

title: List project lessons
